test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a mountain pass in the Pir Panjal range at a maximum altitude of 2832 metres that connects the Kashmir Valley in the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir with the Outer Himalayas and the plains in the south?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Banihal Pass**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Banihal Pass **is a mountain pass across the Pir Panjal Range at a maximum elevation of 2,832 m (9,291 ft).
 
• It** joins **the Kashmir Valley in the union territory of Jammu and Kashmir to the outer Himalayas and the plains to the south.
 
• The road from **Jammu to Srinagar transversed Banihal Pass until 1956 when the Jawahar Tunnel was constructed under the pass.**
 
• The road now passes through the underpass and the **Banihal Pass is no longer used for road transport.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mana Pass is located **within the Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve, 47 km north of the town of Mana, India, and 52 km north of the Hindu pilgrimage town of Badrinath in Uttarakhand**.
 
• Bara-lacha la also known as Bara-lacha Pass, (el. 4,850 m or 15,910 ft) is a high mountain pass in the Zanskar range, connecting **Lahaul district in Himachal Pradesh to Leh district in Ladakh**.
 
• Zoji-La Pass is a high mountain pass that runs **through the Kashmir valley to Ladakh**.
